segments.text: Drop an iron nut in water and it sinks right away.
But the boat right next to it is iron too, and it floats.
A submerged object gets pushed up by the water it displaces.
The nut is small, so it barely pushes any water aside.
A ship is shaped like a hollow bowl, so it takes up way more space.
Even just the submerged part pushes aside a lot of water.
That's why this boat stays floating.
The steel isn't lighter, it just takes up more room.
